title: Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44): Form Charge on a Fee Charged Again
content:
A re-charge form charge is added to a fee charged again under Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44), which is the fee charged on a filing whose fee charges were all reversed in full as charged in error. It follows the certificate form the backing term is written to back. That form is the financial responsibility filing recorded on the Owner Auto Policy term or the Named Non-Owner Policy term.

- A term written to back an FR-44 adds 10.00.
- A term written to back an SR-22 adds 2.00.
- A term recorded as backing none adds no re-charge form charge.

*Hypothetical:* an Owner Auto Policy term recorded as written to back an SR-22 adds 2.00. The same term recorded as backing none adds nothing under this rule.
